title: Highly flexible hybrid devices enabled by Ag-decorated ZnCo2O4 electrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37392-37399
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05871B, Paper
Open Access

Xingjie Sun, Wei-chao Zhang, Xiang Wu
We synthesize Ag-ZnCo2O4 composites with a unique mesoporous structure by a hydrothermal strategy. The assemble asymmetric SCs deliver a specific capacity of 253.33 F g−1 at 0.5 A g−1.
